title: How Event Sourcing works #147 #cs
description:
Event Sourcing is a complete play-by-play recording.
#programming #coding #softwaredevelopment #cs
transcript: Most engineers treat databases as the current source of truth. That works until the history matters. Most systems store the latest state by default. When a user updates their profile, the main record now shows the newest version. Unless history is designed in, previous context can disappear. Event sourcing stores every change as an immutable event. The current state is calculated by playing those events forward. Now the system has a replayable audit trail. Standard tables are a final scoreboard. Event sourcing is a complete play-by-play recording.
